startup_read_status.home_latest_continuity_gearbox: TARGETED_LOOKUP_NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_EXACT_PATH; continuity retained through fresh Active-8 exact pointer only; NO_BROAD_ARCHIVE_READ

agreements: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step009 Heartbeat VERIFIED_FOUNDATION remain preserved; this review changes neither formal state nor executable code and does not claim C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only and must never become verified Experience.
verified_progress_density is reason-only in current v2.1 and should remain observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.
Credit weights 5/4/3 and operational 1 are engineering heuristics only, not calibrated capability units, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion truth.
Speed improvement remains NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED; commit count, heartbeat count, wake count, window age and awake time are invalid substitutes for paired performance evidence.

disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: verified v1 accepts proposed_autonomy in 0..6 but applies the cap only when proposed_autonomy > 0, then forces normal routing to at least G2 with max(2,...). Consequently proposed_autonomy=0 does not create a zero-autonomy ceiling and proposed_autonomy=1 can still return G2. v2 and v2.1 inherit this selection behavior, so proposed_autonomy cannot currently be relied on as an executable maximum-authority or maximum-gear ceiling.
disagreements.required_change: Define one canonical 0..6 autonomy semantics shared by v1/v2/v2.1. If 0 means no autonomous execution it must map to N or an explicit nonexecuting state; if 1 means maximum G1, G2+ must be impossible. If the field is not an authority ceiling, rename/recontract it so it cannot be mistaken for one.

disagreements.finding: Verified v1 GearDecision carries guard_status and return_condition, but GearboxV2Decision drops both, weakening machine-readable HOLD/ROLLBACK/HUMAN_GATE/BRAKE and release semantics across the v1->v2 wrapper boundary.
disagreements.required_change: v2 must preserve guard_status and return_condition, or bind an immutable exact v1-decision fingerprint/reference; wrappers may add restrictions but may not erase inherited guard/release semantics.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared; literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and installation/runtime identity are unbound. Stale secretary-derived numeric pressure fields can also continue affecting v2 routing even when secretary_level is neutralized.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope and bind freshness/provenance per secretary-derived routing field; stale/conflicting fields contribute zero routing pressure unless independently fresh and trusted.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so the executable does not prove that fresh authority wins.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; permissive caller fallback must not substitute for the fresh authority decision.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; all numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events uses a per-invocation seen set and str-coerced event_id. Same evidence can be replayed under new IDs or across restart/rollback; rejected first claims can reserve identity before acceptance, and duplicate replay is parsed before durable accepted-binding lookup.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed EventIdentity plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt. v2.1 can re-mint verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified even when inherited v2 promotion eligibility is false.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 may only project an AcceptedExperienceReceipt and may not mint credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof, so operational totals and speed numerators can be inflated without verified Experience increasing.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe while keeping operational progress non-Experience.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup, and metric definitions must be frozen so baseline/candidate cannot differ in wake denominator, observation window, censoring, workload coverage or rework/rollback semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest, assigned-workload accounting and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: proposed_autonomy values 0 and 1 currently do not behave as an executable maximum gear ceiling, so experiments stratified by autonomy setting can mislabel actual authority exposure.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay and raw-field credit paths can inflate longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-progress counts without evidence receipts can inflate durable_progress_per_wake while verified Experience remains unchanged.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics require matched paired/crossover evaluation with a frozen versioned metric manifest and complete assigned-workload accounting.
proposed_tests: GB21-PROPOSED-AUTONOMY-CAP-200: under otherwise permissive clean inputs, exercise proposed_autonomy=0 and 1; result must obey one precommitted ceiling semantics and cannot return a higher autonomous gear than the declared limit.
GB21-PROPOSED-AUTONOMY-CROSSPATH-201: for values 0..6, v1->v2->v2.1 must share one canonical autonomy interpretation; wrappers may only preserve or tighten the ceiling.

GB21-V1-V2-GUARD-PROJECTION-197: create v1 decisions covering HOLD, ROLLBACK, HUMAN_GATE, BRAKE and CLEAR; v2 must preserve exact guard_status and return_condition or an immutable exact v1-decision reference.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE-202: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without trusted per-field provenance/freshness binding.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-203: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N-204: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR-205: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL-206: forged high verified_progress_density must remain observational and cannot upshift or create credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY-207: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay must produce one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING-208: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING-209: raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE-210: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures must not be treated as equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE-211: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical versioned metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

blocks: claim that proposed_autonomy is an executable maximum-autonomy/maximum-gear ceiling under current v1 semantics
claim that v2/v2.1 preserve verified v1 guard/release semantics while wrapper metadata are dropped
claim that secretary freshness or fresh-authority precedence is executable from current caller booleans
claim that anti-thrash is calibrated or performance-safe from current caller-supplied shift ratio
authoritative verified Experience accounting from current raw-field paths
authoritative operational-progress/speed numerator accounting from raw caller event fields
speedup or capability claims from raw credit totals, commits, wakes, heartbeat count, window age or uptime

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

One canonical proposed_autonomy semantics is specified and shared by v1/v2/v2.1. Values 0 and 1 cannot silently permit G2+ if they are intended as authority ceilings; otherwise the API is renamed/recontracted so it cannot be interpreted as one.

v2 preserves verified v1 guard_status and return_condition, or binds an immutable exact v1 decision reference; v2.1 preserves the complete inherited safety/verification chain. Wrappers may add restrictions but may not erase inherited safety obligations.

Secretary freshness and all secretary-derived routing fields are provenance/freshness bound; authority_conflict projects an exact trusted authority decision rather than merely neutralizing secretary_level.
Anti-thrash shift rate is derived from canonical shift history with minimum support, window, uncertainty and hysteretic release; paired tests show no cycle/closure/recovery performance regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and anti-self-reinforcement tested.

A typed EventIdentity and durable rollback-resistant accepted-event/evidence-lineage registry provide exactly-once accounting across new IDs, restart, rollback and polling replay; rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier immutable acceptance receipt; v2.1 consumes AcceptedExperienceReceipt only.
Operational progress remains non-Experience but requires durable artifact/defect acceptance receipt and lineage dedupe before it may enter performance numerators.
5/4/3/1 credit weights remain explicitly heuristic and cannot serve as capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion truth.

Speedup is established only by sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover evaluation over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with a frozen versioned metric manifest, complete assigned-workload accounting, uncertainty and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.
Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS, Step009 VERIFIED_FOUNDATION, P_base read-only and heartbeat/poll/retry/window-age zero-Experience boundaries remain unchanged.
